gloss: to stroke all over; to rub repeatedly; to fondle

definitions.gloss: to stroke all over; to pet repeatedly; to rub lovingly
definitions.explanation: To run one's hands over something or someone repeatedly and affectionately. Often used when petting an animal or touching something with great care or affection.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}を{撫|な}で{回|まわ}した。
examples.english: I petted the cat all over.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもが{犬|いぬ}を{嬉|うれ}しそうに{撫|な}で{回|まわ}していた。
examples.english: The child was happily stroking the dog all over.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しく{買|か}った{革|かわ}のバッグを、うっとりと{撫|な}で{回|まわ}した。
examples.english: I lovingly ran my hands all over my newly purchased leather bag.

notes:
A compound verb from {撫|な}でる (to stroke, to pet) + {回|まわ}す (to turn, to move around). Godan verb conjugating as {撫|な}で{回|まわ}さない, {撫|な}で{回|まわ}します, etc. The 〜{回|まわ}す suffix adds the nuance of doing something thoroughly or all over.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {猫|ねこ}を{撫|な}で{回|まわ}す: to pet a cat all over
- {頭|あたま}を{撫|な}で{回|まわ}す: to stroke someone's head repeatedly
- {体|からだ}を{撫|な}で{回|まわ}す: to rub one's body all over

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS WITH 〜{回|まわ}す:
- {振|ふ}り{回|まわ}す: to swing around
- {走|はし}り{回|まわ}る: to run around
- {見|み}{回|まわ}す: to look around
